The '''iceberg''' is a plain iceberg in the sea. It is the location of the [[KGP Headquarters]] [[Penguin (race)|penguin]] base. It can only be accessed by those who have gone halfway through [[Cold War]].

Players can travel back to the iceberg after the quest is completed by talking to [[Larry]] on the dock north-east of [[Rellekka]].

If one is wearing a [[clockwork suit]], it can be entered via the [[Avalanche (scenery)]] to the north-west of [[Larry's boat]]. This is required for the [[Clue scroll (master)|master clue]] [[Treasure Trails/Guide/Cryptic clues|cryptic step]].

==Notable features==
*[[Penguin agility course]]

==Personalities==
*[[Pescaling Pax]] - Son of the king of the penguins, and is also leading the penguins to war against the rest of the world.
*[[Ping]] and [[Pong]] - These are two musical penguins who are annoyed that most instruments require thumbs and fingers to play. During [[Cold War]], you have to give them some bongos and a cowbell. Because of this, they nearly get thrown into solitary.

==Monsters==
*[[Icelord]] (level 51)

==Quests==
*[[Cold War]] is greatly involved with the iceberg.
